panels.title: Daily unique visitors
panels.description: Distinct visitor IPs per day; bots excluded by user-agent heuristic. IP-based, so treat as an approximation.

targets.rawSQL: WITH logs AS (SELECT DISTINCT request_id, "date", c_ip, useragent FROM access_logs) SELECT date_parse("date", '%Y-%m-%d') AS time, count(DISTINCT c_ip) AS visitors FROM logs WHERE NOT regexp_like(useragent, '(?i)(bot|crawl|spider|scan|slurp|curl|wget|python|httpx|okhttp|scrapy|censys|netcraft|gpt|openai|anthropic|claude|facebookexternalhit|headless|dataprovider|internet-measurement|go-http|java|libwww|masscan|zgrab|nuclei|expanse|paloalto)') AND $__timeFilter(date_parse("date", '%Y-%m-%d')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Requests: people vs. bots
panels.description: All requests per day split by user-agent heuristic.

targets.rawSQL: WITH logs AS (SELECT DISTINCT request_id, "date", useragent FROM access_logs) SELECT date_parse("date", '%Y-%m-%d') AS time, count(CASE WHEN NOT regexp_like(useragent, '(?i)(bot|crawl|spider|scan|slurp|curl|wget|python|httpx|okhttp|scrapy|censys|netcraft|gpt|openai|anthropic|claude|facebookexternalhit|headless|dataprovider|internet-measurement|go-http|java|libwww|masscan|zgrab|nuclei|expanse|paloalto)') THEN 1 END) AS human, count(CASE WHEN regexp_like(useragent, '(?i)(bot|crawl|spider|scan|slurp|curl|wget|python|httpx|okhttp|scrapy|censys|netcraft|gpt|openai|anthropic|claude|facebookexternalhit|headless|dataprovider|internet-measurement|go-http|java|libwww|masscan|zgrab|nuclei|expanse|paloalto)') THEN 1 END) AS bot FROM logs WHERE $__timeFilter(date_parse("date", '%Y-%m-%d')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Where visitors connect from
panels.description: Each marker is the CloudFront edge that served the requests, sized by volume. Edges sit near visitors but are not their exact location.

targets.rawSQL: WITH logs AS (SELECT DISTINCT request_id, "date", edge_location, useragent FROM access_logs) SELECT substr(edge_location, 1, 3) AS edge, count(*) AS requests FROM logs WHERE NOT regexp_like(useragent, '(?i)(bot|crawl|spider|scan|slurp|curl|wget|python|httpx|okhttp|scrapy|censys|netcraft|gpt|openai|anthropic|claude|facebookexternalhit|headless|dataprovider|internet-measurement|go-http|java|libwww|masscan|zgrab|nuclei|expanse|paloalto)') AND $__timeFilter(date_parse("date", '%Y-%m-%d')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Most-visited pages
panels.description: Successful page loads by visitors; assets and known probe paths excluded.

targets.rawSQL: WITH logs AS (SELECT DISTINCT request_id, "date", uri_stem, status, useragent FROM access_logs) SELECT uri_stem AS page, count(*) AS views FROM logs WHERE NOT regexp_like(useragent, '(?i)(bot|crawl|spider|scan|slurp|curl|wget|python|httpx|okhttp|scrapy|censys|netcraft|gpt|openai|anthropic|claude|facebookexternalhit|headless|dataprovider|internet-measurement|go-http|java|libwww|masscan|zgrab|nuclei|expanse|paloalto)') AND substr(status, 1, 1) IN ('2', '3') AND NOT regexp_like(uri_stem, '(?i)\.(js|css|png|jpe?g|svg|ico|woff2?|ttf|map|json|webp|gif|txt|xml)$') AND uri_stem <> '/ip' AND $__timeFilter(date_parse("date", '%Y-%m-%d')) GROUP BY uri_stem ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Edge locations (exact counts)
panels.description: Nearest CloudFront edge (IATA airport code) — a rough proxy for visitor geography.

targets.rawSQL: WITH logs AS (SELECT DISTINCT request_id, "date", edge_location, useragent FROM access_logs) SELECT substr(edge_location, 1, 3) AS edge, count(*) AS requests FROM logs WHERE NOT regexp_like(useragent, '(?i)(bot|crawl|spider|scan|slurp|curl|wget|python|httpx|okhttp|scrapy|censys|netcraft|gpt|openai|anthropic|claude|facebookexternalhit|headless|dataprovider|internet-measurement|go-http|java|libwww|masscan|zgrab|nuclei|expanse|paloalto)') AND $__timeFilter(date_parse("date", '%Y-%m-%d')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Status codes (visitors)
panels.description: Response status distribution for non-bot requests.

targets.rawSQL: WITH logs AS (SELECT DISTINCT request_id, "date", status, useragent FROM access_logs) SELECT status, count(*) AS requests FROM logs WHERE NOT regexp_like(useragent, '(?i)(bot|crawl|spider|scan|slurp|curl|wget|python|httpx|okhttp|scrapy|censys|netcraft|gpt|openai|anthropic|claude|facebookexternalhit|headless|dataprovider|internet-measurement|go-http|java|libwww|masscan|zgrab|nuclei|expanse|paloalto)') AND $__timeFilter(date_parse("date", '%Y-%m-%d')) GROUP BY status ORDER BY requests DESC

panels.title: External referrers
panels.description: Where visitors arrive from. Most traffic is direct (no referrer) and not shown.

targets.rawSQL: WITH logs AS (SELECT DISTINCT request_id, "date", referer, useragent FROM access_logs) SELECT referer, count(*) AS requests FROM logs WHERE referer NOT IN ('-', '') AND referer NOT LIKE '%veda.grss-ieee.org%' AND referer NOT LIKE '%localhost%' AND NOT regexp_like(useragent, '(?i)(bot|crawl|spider|scan|slurp|curl|wget|python|httpx|okhttp|scrapy|censys|netcraft|gpt|openai|anthropic|claude|facebookexternalhit|headless|dataprovider|internet-measurement|go-http|java|libwww|masscan|zgrab|nuclei|expanse|paloalto)') AND $__timeFilter(date_parse("date", '%Y-%m-%d')) GROUP BY referer ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top bot user agents
panels.description: Raw user-agent strings classified as bots, by request volume.

targets.rawSQL: WITH logs AS (SELECT DISTINCT request_id, "date", useragent FROM access_logs) SELECT useragent, count(*) AS requests FROM logs WHERE regexp_like(useragent, '(?i)(bot|crawl|spider|scan|slurp|curl|wget|python|httpx|okhttp|scrapy|censys|netcraft|gpt|openai|anthropic|claude|facebookexternalhit|headless|dataprovider|internet-measurement|go-http|java|libwww|masscan|zgrab|nuclei|expanse|paloalto)') AND $__timeFilter(date_parse("date", '%Y-%m-%d')) GROUP BY useragent ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 10
